rule.name: ProcessWaitWithoutTimeout
rule.message: Wait with a deadline: process.waitFor(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS), and call process.destroyForcibly() when it returns false. Read the output on another thread (or redirect it to a file) before that wait. This waits for the child process without a deadline, so a command that never exits hangs this request, job or command for good. An exception fits only a program whose purpose is to run the child to completion, such as a build wrapper.
